MANAGER is looking

for a strong #-
MON trainer.

He needs help
getting back

was stolen.

got back together

in JOHTO but fell
apart right away.

I didn't know any-
thing about that.

side, you can see

the roof of a big
building.

That's the POWER
PLANT.
